en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The justice is sweeter than the honey, and softer than the butter, and more aromatic than the musk’.
en.sarwar: 15. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ibn Mahbub from Mu’awiyah ibn Wahab from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Justice is sweeter than honey, softer than butter and smells sweeter than musk.”
